prompt: In the style of Dungeons & Dragons official book illustration — high quality, high fidelity, digitally painted: A warm, stocky middle-aged druid crouches down on one knee on a misty jungle floor, leaning forward with wide, wonder-struck eyes and a breathless smile — the expression of someone witnessing something rare and magical. He wears worn, earthy brown robes and a roughspun cloak, patched and soil-dusted. His beard is full and unkempt, his wide-brimmed hat slightly crooked. He holds a gnarled wooden staff topped with twisted branches wrapped around a softly glowing green stone. Gathered around him are several Chwingas — tiny, mysterious nature spirits, no bigger than a fist, with small dark bodies, wispy curling tendrils, and simple white oval mask-faces with hollow eyes. They glow faintly. One perches in his outstretched open palm. Others peer out from oversized jungle leaves with slow, cautious curiosity. Softly glowing white flowers dot the ground around them. The jungle floor is lush and misty, with thick broad leaves and soft light filtering down through the canopy. The mood is hushed and magical — a man holding his breath so he doesn't scare something wonderful away.
